title: Bridge error
description:
Closed error taxonomy. Callers branch on `code`; people read `message` and `detail`.

The set is closed on purpose. An open-ended string means every consumer substring-matches on prose, and the prose then cannot be improved without breaking them.

code.description: `capability_denied` = the caller's grants do not cover it (a permission problem). `capability_unavailable` = granted, but not usable right now (an operational problem). Conflating them sends users to fix the wrong thing.

message.description: One sentence, safe to show a user. No credentials, no stack traces.

detail.description: What to do about it. Required for `capability_unavailable`.

capability.description: Dotted capability id. `oaiy.*` is reserved for the platform; products and plugins own their own namespace (`connector.aokie.*`).

retryable.description: True only when the outcome can change on a retry. A malformed flow, a denied capability and a deterministic 4xx are all false — re-driving them just burns the ledger.
